mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over a three-month period signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a decline in corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level below 1500.0 thousand units indicates a contraction in the residential construction sector, which is a leading indicator of reduced consumer spending and corporate revenue, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 105.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services output, which typically leads to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in the unemployment rate (indicating a monetary easing response to a deteriorating labor market) signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months
regime_hint: monetary easing amid labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS falls > 0.1pp and UNRATE rises > 0.1pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) level above $570 billion indicates excessive consumer spending that may trigger monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 570.0 during late-cycle expansion, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained level of industrial production (INDPRO) above 108.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates robust economic activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO > 108.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.25 percentage points within a single month signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which typically causes a short-term sell-off in equities, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year window is below 0.03.
